decisions.quote: Moran et al. (2017, VSS) found that realistic miniature increased immersion relative to unrealistic miniatures, but memory was unaffected. However, the questions used to assess memory were very easy, raising the possibility of a ceiling effect. The current experiment was very similar to Moran et al. (2017).
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this work. The source is a 2018 conference abstract (VSS) with no reference list. It cites 'Moran et al. (2017, VSS)' (sharing co-author Matt Moran with the present abstract) and states that the current experiment was very similar to Moran et al. (2017), while also directly comparing its failed immersion result to shipped row 2364 (Baranowski; Hecht, 2014, 'The Big Picture: Effects of Surround on Immersion and Size Perception', DOI 10.1068/p7663). Because only the abstract is supplied and no title, full author list, DOI, or reference entry is available for Moran et al. (2017, VSS), the evidence cannot establish a complete source-backed bibliographic identity or resolve whether Moran et al. (2017, VSS) is an independent target versus a preliminary conference presentation from the same ongoing replication of Baranowski & Hecht (2014).
